groups.label: Organizations create AI leadership titles faster than establishing real accountability
groups.pov: Titles signal intent; accountability follows execution, and you can't govern what you can't trace. If your AI owner can't answer "which decision changed which outcome and why," you don't have an accountability structure—you have an org chart.
